description:
The image shows a glass-front refrigerator filled with cakes, specifically Hello Kitty tortas.

In the foreground, the cakes are arranged on white wire racks. The cakes are round with pink and white frosting and are decorated with Hello Kitty figurines and sprinkles. One cake has a sign in front of it that reads "Torta Hello Kitty 25,00 Kg" in black letters.
